title: Parity acceptance probability
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be a set of coordinates. The acceptance probability of the sign-AND tester on the parity function $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ is $\frac12+\left(\frac34-\frac14(-1)^{|S|}\right)2^{-|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $S$ of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
